trickyParts: The label value is quoted in the manifest (sequence-run: "$run") because eight hex characters can be all digits, which YAML would read as a number and the API would refuse as a label value.
The label is on the Job's metadata only, not the pod template: the pod's labels in every run lack it, so it cannot be read as the reachability label.
No Service exists on the label path: the Service is applied only after the name is read, so the no-name branch deletes Jobs alone.
A stop before the trap is installed (0.10 s) still prints nothing and leaves the mktemp directory; that ordering predates this pull request and creates nothing in the cluster.
